summary: Episode discusses multiple sectors including affiliate companies with poor Q1 results, takeover activity in UK, and tech companies showing growth potential. Peers has potential Grindr collaboration but weak cash flow. Affiliate sector facing challenges with Katina Media, Gen2 Media, and RakeTech all reporting significant declines. Kinovo received takeover bid deemed potentially low. Gig Software shows promise with insider buying. Ubico interesting on dips. Remittly continues strong performance with positive earnings. Broadleaf transitioning to cloud with expected margin expansion.
key_takeaways: Affiliate sector under pressure with multiple companies reporting >40% revenue declines and strategic shifts including cost cuts and potential consolidation
UK market presenting takeover opportunities with Kinovo bid at 87.5 pence
Gig Software spinning off with compliance platform strategy and strong insider support
Remittly achieving profitability with 34% revenue growth and scaling operations
